faq_heading: Homes near Fraser Wood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Fraser Wood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Fraser Wood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Fraser Wood Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Fraser Wood Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 34 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,400,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Fraser Wood Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Fraser Wood Elementary the median was 18 days on the market, closing at 96.5% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 34 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Fraser Wood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Fraser Heights Secondary (0.8 km west), Erma Stephenson Elementary (1.0 km north-west) and Pacific Academy (1.1 km south-east).

Fraser Wood Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10650 164 St. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Intensive French (6-7).
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Fraser Wood Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Fraser Wood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Fraser Wood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Fraser Wood Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 34 homes sold within 1 km of Fraser Wood Elementary: 34 houses. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,400,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Fraser Wood Elementary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Fraser Wood Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 3 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Fraser Heights Secondary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Mountainview Montessori, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Erma Stephenson Elementary (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Pacific Academy (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Erma Stephenson Elementary (1.0 km north-west), Dogwood Elementary (1.4 km west), Harold Bishop Elementary (1.6 km west), Bothwell Elementary School (1.6 km south-east), William F. Davidson Elementary (2.3 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Erma Stephenson Elementary, 1.0 km north-west of Fraser Wood Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Fraser Wood Elementary was $1,400,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
